name: Futagawa Keiji
source:
The protagonist of the story.
He is active as a professional gamer while attending school.
Although he has a slightly nervous and sensitive side, he is a straightforward and good-natured person at heart.
However, he is somewhat shy and is awkward around real-life women.
He lives alone due to his work, but ends up living together with Kanata, who suddenly appeared from his monitor one day.
